title_en: Rantau Panjang AKPS foils attempt to smuggle banned species of shrimp from Thailand
summary_en: PASIR MAS: The Rantau Panjang Border Control and Protection Agency (AKPS) foiled the first attempt to smuggle in 100 kilogrammes of tiger prawns from Thailand since the temporary ban on the importation of these fishes was imposed by the Thai government.
